code:
$ journalctl -u nginx          # everything nginx has logged
$ journalctl -u nginx -f       # follow it live
$ journalctl -u sshd --since "10 min ago"
$ journalctl -b                # since the current boot
caption: -u filters to one service, -f follows live, --since filters by time.

code:
$ tail -f /var/log/syslog
# new lines as they're written

$ tail -n 100 /var/log/auth.log | grep "Failed password"
# last 100 lines, filtered to failed SSH logins
caption: tail -f watches live; grep filters a log down to what you actually care about.
